annotations.title: What your farming budget buys on each perp DEX (Pro, 0.5 USDC)

description: PAID: 0.5 USDC on Base per route (free if no venue gives a figure), via x402 (no account; an x402-enabled client pays automatically). For your weekly budget and order size: on every perp DEX with a published weekly points pool, the volume it buys at the all-in cost of your size on the live book (fees + slippage), the share of this week's pool that takes once your own volume dilutes it, and the same with limit orders if they fill. Points of different venues are not comparable and are never summed.

monthly_volume_usd.description: Your 30-day volume in USD, to pick your fee tier (default 0)

pair.description: Base asset of the perpetual, e.g. BTC

weekly_budget_usd.description: What you will spend on trading costs this week, USD (default 500)
